text:
A radioactive substance has a half-life of 6 hours.
It has an initial rate of emission of 120 counts per second.
How long will it take for this rate of emission to fall to 30 counts per second?
A
1.5 hours
B
12 hours
C
30 hours
D
240 hours
subject: Physics
